findings.message: 5 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Shop luôn quyết định" above "L"; "Chăm sóc khách hàng" (pill) above "Mỗi câu hỏi đều xứng đáng được quan tâm."; "Livestream assistant" (pill) above "Bạn giữ nhịp live. theo nhịp khách."; "Marketing assistant" (pill) above "Từ sản phẩm quen thuộc đến một góc kể mớ"; "Sales assistant" (pill) above "Hiểu điều khách cần. Tư vấn điều phù hợp"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 5 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: figure.landing-module__ue1IDW__floating-card.landing-module_ → rgba(37, 39, 34, 0.14) 0px 18px 40px -12px | figure.landing-module__ue1IDW__floating-card.landing-module_ → rgba(37, 39, 34, 0.14) 0px 18px 40px -12px | div.landing-module__ue1IDW__floating-card.landing-module__ue → rgba(37, 39, 34, 0.14) 0px 18px 40px -12px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 27 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.landing-module__ue1IDW__header 1440px | div.landing-module__ue1IDW__workspace-bar 848px | div.landing-module__ue1IDW__workspace-tabs 849px | div.landing-module__ue1IDW__conversations 229px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.
Remove unless it is a real drop zone.

findings.message: Cream + terracotta palette (page background #faf9f8, section #faf8f5, section #fffefa, section #eee9df).
findings.fix: Re-draw the palette from the library. This pairing reads as an assistant brand, not yours.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "Chăm sóc khách hàng" 4.2:1 needs 4.5:1; "Livestream assistant" 4.2:1 needs 4.5:1; "Marketing assistant" 4.2:1 needs 4.5:1; "Sales assistant" 4.2:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 13px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 768px: "Bạn giữ nhịp live. theo nhịp khách." → 3 lines (7 words, 28px); "Từ sản phẩm quen thuộc đến một góc kể mới." → 3 lines (10 words, 28px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 32px or less.

findings.message: The margins differ: 28px on the left, 46px on the right, at 768px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.
